candidate.body:
A fabricated astronomical archive has allocated a reading room to star charts made from stitched cloth. Visitors examine patterns that belong to an entirely invented sky.

The catalogue groups these imaginary constellations by shape. A rotating display presents a different selection each afternoon.

El desfile cruza un puente de cartón. Cada parada propone un ritmo distinto para este paseo alegre e imaginario.

Les visiteurs choisissent un point de départ sur une carte vide. Ils composent ensuite un itinéraire dans ce paysage entièrement inventé.
